title: Akber Ali Akbar Haaye Akbar Ali Akbar
body:
AKBER ALI AKBER HAYE AKBER ALI AKBER
ZAINAB KI SADA THI MERE DILBAR ALI AKBER
Maa Kheti Thi Humshakl-e-Payaimber Mere Dilbar
Takti Rahi Naize Pe Tera Sar Mere Dilbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab kaise Jiyegi Teri Madar Ali Akber
Zalim Ne Tere Sine Pe Jo Mara Hai Bhala
Kya Hogi Aziyath Tujhe Allaha Wo Naiza
Tuta Jo Tere Qalb Ke Ander Ali Akber
<<DIVIDER>>
Kheti Hai Har Ek Pal Mere Bhayya Mere Bhayya
Takti hu Jo Usko Tho Laraz Jati Hu Beta
Roti Hai Sakina Jo Tadapkar Ali Akber
Athara Baras Pala Tha Maine Tujhe Beta
<<DIVIDER>>
Armaan Tha Dekhu Tuhje Bandhe Huwe Shehra
Ab Jism Tera Khoon Me Hai Tar Ali Akber
Kya Aala-e-Tanhai Me Rheti Hai Wo Dukhya
Din Raat Tujhe Yaad Kiya Karti Hai Sughra
<<DIVIDER>>
Har Lamha Tadapti Hai wo Muztar Ali Akber
Mai Souchti Hu Jake Madine Me Karu Kya
Pouchegi Jo Sughra Tumhe Batlao Kahu Kya
Chlata Hai Mere Qalb Pe Qanjar Ali Akber
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhulega Na Ahsan koi Iss Gham Ka Fasana
Roega Rulaega Issi Gham Me Zamana
Matam Tera Hoega Har Ek Ghar Ali Akber
